blocks.text: 微软董事长兼首席执行官萨提亚·纳德拉今早在旧金山 Ignite 大会上发表开幕主题演讲。以下是其演讲的编辑版本。

inlines.text: 微软董事长兼首席执行官萨提亚·纳德拉今早在
旧金山 Ignite 大会
上发表开幕主题演讲。以下是其演讲的编辑版本。

blocks.text: 本周聚焦两件事：第一，我们如何利用呈指数级增长的新能力；第二，我们如何构建应对这些指数级增长所带来的后果的能力。

inlines.text: 本周聚焦两件事：第一，我们如何利用呈指数级增长的新能力；第二，我们如何构建应对这些指数级增长所带来的后果的能力。

blocks.text: 在这样的时刻，我总觉得回归我们的使命很有帮助：赋能地球上的每一个人和每一个组织，成就不凡。在当今世界，这意味着构建一个前沿生态。我们需要把任何技术进步转化为实实在在的成果，为个人、组织乃至整个社会创造新的杠杆点。

blocks.text: 对我们而言，这归结为三件事：以人为本、确保组织对自身智能与学习的掌控，以及信任。

blocks.text: Copilot

inlines.text: Copilot

blocks.text: Copilot 是工作的新操作系统。它把人机交互的各种新形态——无论是 Chat、Cowork、Code 还是 Autopilot——整合为一种体验，也把知识工作、编程和业务流程这些原本割裂的类别汇聚到一起。正因如此，我们把功能丰富的整套 Office 融入 Copilot。而其底层是一个模型系统，能够为合适的场景、合适的交互形态匹配恰当的智能，从而完成任务。

inlines.text: 模型

blocks.text: 对我们来说，关键是为特定任务匹配最合适的智能，并实现最佳的经济性。这一点只有我们能做到：针对真实世界的任务，端到端地调优产品、harness 和工具以及模型系统。

inlines.text: 对我们来说，关键是为特定任务匹配最合适的智能，并实现最佳的经济性。这一点只有我们能做到：针对真实世界的任务，端到端地调优产品、harness 和工具以及模型系统。

blocks.text: 今天，我们非常高兴地宣布 Microsoft-Decision-1.1 正式可用，已准备好投入企业部署。我们新增了多模态支持，并提升了性能，让决策更准确、响应更迅速。目前已有超过 4,000 家客户在使用它。我们自己也把它用于路由、数据标注、个性化、内容过滤等核心任务以及数百个其他场景。

blocks.text: 首先是 Code。我们推出全新的旗舰级智能体编程模型系列：Code 2。Code 2 在日常企业编程任务上处于成本效益的前沿。它擅长将代码推向生产、深度调试、多文件实现、全仓库推理和 UI，而成本仅为前沿模型的一小部分。

inlines.text: 首先是 Code。我们推出全新的旗舰级智能体编程模型系列：Code 2。Code 2 在日常企业编程任务上处于成本效益的前沿。它擅长将代码推向生产、深度调试、多文件实现、全仓库推理和 UI，而成本仅为前沿模型的一小部分。

blocks.text: Code 2 Flash 专为快速、高吞吐的工作而设计，比如代码解释、定向编辑、常规修复和快速迭代。它以低得多的成本带来接近旗舰级的水准。这两款模型今天都已在 GitHub Copilot 上正式可用，既出现在模型选择器中，也作为 Copilot Fusion 的一部分提供。它们同样已在 Foundry 中上线。

blocks.text: Satya Nadella, Microsoft Chairman and CEO, delivered the opening keynote at Ignite in San Francisco this morning. Here is an edited version of his remarks.

inlines.text: Satya Nadella, Microsoft Chairman and CEO, delivered the opening keynote at
Ignite in San Francisco
this morning. Here is an edited version of his remarks.

blocks.text: This week is about two things: First is how we capitalize on new capabilities that are growing exponentially. And second is how do we build the capability to deal with the consequences of these exponentials.

inlines.text: This week is about two things: First is how we capitalize on new capabilities that are growing exponentially. And second is how do we build the capability to deal with the consequences of these exponentials.

blocks.text: At times like these, I always find it helpful to be grounded in our mission: To empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. In today’s world, that means building a frontier ecosystem. We need to parlay any technological advance into real outcomes and new points of leverage for people, organizations and society at large.

inlines.text: At times like these, I always find it helpful to be grounded in our mission: To empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. blocks.text: For us, that comes down to three things: Keeping human ambition at the center, ensuring your control of your organization’s intelligence and learning, and trust.

inlines.text: For us, that comes down to three things: Keeping human ambition at the center, ensuring your control of your organization’s intelligence and learning, and trust.

blocks.text: And so, our goal is to build a stack that addresses these three core architectural principles.

blocks.text: Copilot

inlines.text: Copilot

blocks.text: Copilot is the new OS for work. Copilot brings together all the new form factors of human-computer interaction, whether it is Chat, Cowork, Code or Autopilot, into one experience. It also brings together the disparate categories of knowledge work, coding and business process. That is why we have all of Office with its richness built into Copilot. And underlying it is a model system that matches the right intelligence to the right context to the right form factor to accomplish the task.

And Autopilot is an autonomous agent that keeps moving your work forward 24×7 in all the places where you and your team collaborate.

blocks.text: The idea behind IQ is to help every organization build, retain and continuously improve its own intelligence. Essentially, we are taking the system we built underneath Copilot and externalizing it as a first-class platform that embodies your organizational intelligence as an asset that you continuously build and control.

blocks.text: We are bringing together all of the data you have across Fabric, Foundry and Microsoft 365. And, of course, all the third-party context too. Microsoft IQ comes with hundreds of new connectors we are announcing today, so agents can get the full enterprise context where business gets done. blocks.text: Models

inlines.text: Models

blocks.text: For us, it is about mapping intelligence to a given task, with the best economics. This is something we can uniquely do in the context of real-world tasks by tuning our products, harness and tools, and the model system, end-to-end.

inlines.text: For us, it is about mapping intelligence to a given task, with the best economics. This is something we can uniquely do in the context of real-world tasks by tuning our products, harness and tools, and the model system, end-to-end.

blocks.text: And today we are thrilled to announce Microsoft-Decision-1.1, which is now generally available and ready for enterprise deployment. We have added multimodal support. And we have improved performance, making decisions more accurate and responses faster. Already, more than 4,000 customers have used it. And we ourselves are using it for core tasks like routing, data labeling, personalization, content filtering and hundreds of other use cases.

blocks.text: Foundry of course has all the most popular closed and open weight models, too. We are very excited to bring GPT 6.2 to Foundry. It is a great model that sets a new bar for AI in professional work. And today we are announcing that Meta’s latest models are all coming to Foundry as well.

blocks.text: We are also innovating at the frontier with our own MAI model family that is both compute-efficient when it comes to pre-training and token-efficient when it comes to product deployment. blocks.text: First, Code. We are introducing our new flagship family of agentic coding models: Code 2. Code 2 is at the frontier of cost-performance for everyday enterprise coding tasks. It excels in taking code to production, deep debugging, multifile implementation, repo-wide reasoning and UI at a fraction of frontier cost.

blocks.text: Code 2 Flash is designed for fast, high-volume work like code explanations, targeted edits, routine fixes and rapid iterations. It brings near-flagship quality for a much lower cost. These models are both generally available today on GitHub Copilot, both in the model picker and as part of Copilot Fusion. They are also available in Foundry.

And, just as we have done with coding, we are co-designing the model with the tools and systems where it will be used. We are integrating Cyber 2 with Perception.

blocks.text: Agent 365

inlines.text: Agent 365

blocks.text: Successfully deploying AI systems starts with making sure you have observability at every layer of the stack. That is where Agent 365 comes in. It is a control plane that extends your existing governance, identity, security and management systems to the agents in your enterprise. We already have over 50 million agents in Agent 365.

blocks.text: And it includes FinOps, too. As AI scales, every organization needs a clear line between what it spends and the value AI creates. That is why today we are announcing Agent 365 Business Analytics. You can think of it as your ERP system for AI usage. You can see exactly what is driving spend. You can connect spend to outcomes to drive business value. And you can optimize ROI across different scenarios.

blocks.text: Security

inlines.text: Security

blocks.text: The next thing I want to talk about is how you take the environment you have set up, from Copilot to IQ to Agent 365, and secure it. And that is where Perception and our security stack comes in. We are building an end-to-end trust platform. We are helping customers both secure their AI deployments and use AI to strengthen their security posture.

inlines.text: The next thing I want to talk about is how you take the environment you have set up, from Copilot to IQ to Agent 365, and secure it. And that is where Perception and our security stack comes in. We are building an end-to-end trust platform. We are helping customers both secure their AI deployments and use AI to strengthen their security posture.

blocks.text: Perception is a complete agentic security system with teams of red, blue and green agents that run through playbooks to deliver security outcomes at machine speed, with you always in control.

blocks.text: Essentially, think about it like this: red team agents simulate attacks, blue team agents detect attacks and green team agents fix and remediate. With Playbooks, you can compose teams of agents to tackle complex jobs and trigger them to take action autonomously.

blocks.text: Perception helps connect all the signals, sensors and actuators across your identity, client, cloud, apps and agents to intelligence to secure your end-to-end environments. And I am very excited to share that Perception is now generally available.

blocks.text: In addition to the work we have been doing across our products, we are also working across the ecosystem to ensure everyone can innovate at speed and scale, safely. Today, we can see almost everything models touch. But we cannot see what happens inside the model. And what the model tells us about itself is not independent evidence. These nested black boxes are simply unacceptable. We need to be able to examine what AI sees and does, verify its actions independently and control what it is allowed to do.

blocks.text: That is why today we are also announcing the Microsoft AI Transparency Initiative.

inlines.text: That is why today we are also announcing the
Microsoft AI Transparency Initiative

blocks.text: There are three parts to this: First, we will expand our collaboration in NIST’s Agent Standards Initiative, drawing on its research to help lead the development of open, industry-wide standards for AI transparency, security and governance.

inlines.text: There are three parts to this: First, we will expand our collaboration in NIST’s Agent Standards Initiative, drawing on its research to help lead the development of open, industry-wide standards for AI transparency, security and governance.

blocks.text: Second, we are taking a full ecosystem approach. Together, we can enable AI systems that are accountable, independently verifiable and safe by design, regardless of the model or provider. Already, 40 organizations are working with us on defining and applying these standards.

blocks.text: Third, we are working to incorporate the same standards in our products, including MAI models, Foundry and Copilot. Our ambition through our research, our product work and our ecosystem is to help establish an open industry standard that makes AI safer, more transparent and more accessible.
